    mean_results = [{"name": str(k), "value": round(float(v), 4)} for k, v in grp_mean.items()]

    grp_count = df_seg.groupby(seg_col)[metric_col].count().sort_values(ascending=False)
    count_results = [{"name": str(k), "value": int(v)} for k, v in grp_count.items()]

    result['segments'] = [
        {
            "segment_column": seg_col,
            "metric_column": metric_col,
            "aggregation": "sum",
